Build a responsive checkout step progress bar component for storefront-web/app/checkout/layout.tsx representing the 4 stages of checkout:
1. Cart Review (icon: ShoppingCart)
2. Delivery Address (icon: MapPin)
3. Payment Method (icon: CreditCard)
4. Order Confirmation (icon: CheckCircle2)

Requirements:
- Connect adjacent step nodes with horizontal connecting line bars on desktop
- Completed steps should show a solid green circular background with a white checkmark icon
- The active current step should have an indigo ring with pulsing dot and bold label

followups: add aria-current='step' to the currently active step list item

Build the core Button component for the @cymbal/ui design system library with complete CVA (class-variance-authority) variant definitions:
- Visual Variants:
  - primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 active:bg-indigo-800 shadow-sm
  - secondary: bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-100 border border-teal-200
  - outline: border border-slate-300 bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800
  - ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700
  - destructive: bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700 active:bg-rose-800
- Size Variants:
  - sm: h-8 px-3 text-xs rounded-md gap-1.5
  - md: h-10 px-4 text-sm rounded-lg gap-2
  - lg: h-12 px-6 text-base rounded-xl gap-2.5
  - icon: h-10 w-10 p-0 rounded-lg
- States & Slots: isLoading state that disables interactions and displays an animated SVG spinner while retaining button width, leftIcon and rightIcon slots with automatic spacing, fullWidth boolean prop, and forwardRef support.

Define the design token schema for @cymbal/ui design system in tokens.json and generate CSS custom variables:
- Spacing Scale: define 4px base grid increments from space-1 (4px) up to space-24 (96px)
- Border Radii: radius-xs (2px), radius-sm (4px), radius-md (8px), radius-lg (12px), radius-xl (16px), radius-2xl (24px), radius-full (9999px)
- Shadows: shadow-card (0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)), shadow-elevated (0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)), shadow-dialog (0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1))
- Typography Scale: display-lg (48px / line-height 56px), heading-xl (36px / 44px), heading-lg (30px / 38px), heading-md (24px / 32px), body-lg (18px / 28px), body-md (14px / 20px), caption (12px / 16px)
- Export tokens into both Tailwind configuration format and CSS custom properties under ':root'.
followups: add a build script to compile tokens into TypeScript type declarations for token autocomplete

text:
Build a fully accessible Modal Dialog component in @cymbal/ui following WAI-ARIA Dialog (Modal) pattern:
- Backdrop: Fixed full-screen backdrop overlay with bg-black/60 and backdrop-blur-sm, fading in over 200ms
- Dialog Surface: Centered container with max-w-lg, bg-white dark:bg-slate-900, rounded-2xl, p-6, shadow-2xl, scaling up from 0.95 to 1.0 on mount
- Keyboard Navigation: Trap focus completely within the modal using a focus sentinel or tab-trap loop; pressing Escape key emits onDismiss callback
- Body Scroll Lock: Prevent background page scrolling while modal is open, preserving scrollbar width to prevent page layout shift
- ARIA Attributes: Attach role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby pointing to header ID, and aria-describedby pointing to description body ID
- Dismiss Button: Accessible close button in top right with aria-label="Close dialog" and high-contrast focus ring.
followups: support size variants for sm, md, lg, and full-screen on mobile
restore focus to the triggering element when the modal is closed

Implement micro-interaction animations across storefront-web using Framer Motion:
- Cart Drawer: Slide in from right edge with spring physics (stiffness: 300, damping: 30) and staggered fade-in for individual cart item rows (staggerChildren: 0.05)
- Add to Cart Button: On tap, scale down to 0.95 then bounce back to 1.0, icon switches from Plus to Animated Checkmark for 1500ms before returning to normal state
- Accordion FAQ: Smooth height animation using AnimatePresence with layout transition to prevent content snapping or jumping
- Notification Toast: Slide down from top-center with slight bounce and swipe-up gesture to manually dismiss
- Ensure all animations respect user system preferences by reading the prefers-reduced-motion media query and disabling motion when active.
followups: wrap all motion components with MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'
add a live preview story in Storybook demonstrating every component switching between light and dark themes
verify all text combinations maintain WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against their respective dark surfaces
